references.phrase: cofinal subset of the well-ordered ordinal α

references.context: Bijective relation-preserving and order-reflecting map giving an ordinal the same order type as a cofinal subset

references.phrase: least order type and minimum-cardinality equivalence
references.disposition: These are two stated characterizations of cf(α) for a fixed ordinal, not unrelated notions or categorical functor cofinality.

review_rationale: Reviewed the ordinal cofinality definition via least ordinal order type of a cofinal subset and its alternative minimum-cardinality characterization; distinguished this from cofinality of a category and from ordinal successor.
